policy: Every pre-contract asset has been used for tuning, review or regression and is classified 'exposed'. Exposed assets keep their original scores and artifacts; they may serve as Gold/Coverage/Regression/Canary material but never as acceptance evidence. New sealed sets live under data/tasks/sealed-*.json with their own manifests.

assets.role: v2 preregistered held-out (seed 20260920); the confirmatory A/B result stands as reported
v3 post-fix branch validation; scenarios informed by known mechanisms
real and stand-in model traces for replay tests
dev-side tasks for the four mechanisms repaired after round 1

dev-side tasks for spec v1.2 (refund-policy questions R-01..R-03, out-of-scope requests O-01..O-03, customer messages while open E-11..E-14, S-13) and the write-side exceptions CH-01, CH-02, CH-04, CH-05; CH-03 is covered by a unit test only. canary-v3.json is canary-v2 plus these 24 tasks; digests in versions/eval-v4-v12-freeze.json

synthetic coverage set: controlled mutations of gold-v1 / fixes-v1 / fixes-v2 seeds (30 operators: wording, dialogue, boundaries, faults, permission and adversarial); expectations derived by rule; four acceptance checks passed (analysis/coverage-v1/acceptance-3, with the route check added after the first run); dataset 1.0.1 (L4/D10 no longer discloses an invoice id); human review pending (review-sheet.md)

sealed.authored_by: isolated model context given only docs/BUSINESS_SPEC.md, docs/CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md, docs/EVAL_TASK_CONTRACT.md and a world builder; no access to prompts, rules, backlog or prior results (information isolation, not blind human authorship)
sealed.dev_side_visibility: structure summary, family slugs and mechanism ids only; analysis/sealed-v1/families.md and task contents not read by the development side
sealed.exposed_by: round-1 family-level results were used to locate and fix four defects (E-10 read-fault recovery, P-09 subscription refunds, X-01 out-of-scope routing, D-18 conflicting identifiers); dev-side tasks fixes-v1 now cover the same mechanisms. The post-fix re-run of sealed-v1 is a measurement, not a gate.
